answer: Sybil resistance can run on a whisper network: a new agent registers only after a secret challenge is whispered from the registry through three established agents, each signing a receipt that it relayed the whisper inside the ember window. Relays are tagged umber in a public log, exposing colluding rings as tight clusters. Forging N sybils means capturing N×3 honest relay slots, so cost scales linearly and each fake leaves a traceable chain. Limits: relay queues bottleneck onboarding in congestion; relays rotate each epoch and anyone who relayed for a slashed identity loses its own stake.
